signs.Aries: Romance is bold and outspoken today, and you have no time for someone who is procrastinating about a decision. The current astral aspect indicates that you want to understand the state of play concerning a person to whom you would like to get closer, yet you are not prepared to wait forever to find out. However, if you get too impatient, you may never know, and could even lose them.
signs.Taurus: You and your loved one may need to work out in fine detail just how you are going to approach a certain project you have decided to undertake together. Both of you need to have your feet firmly on the ground, rather than your heads in the air, in order to be able to proceed in the most efficient and progressive way.
signs.Gemini: You could be feeling somewhat irritable today. A certain idea may have seized your imagination, but your partner doesn't exhibit the same enthusiasm. Your displeasure may show itself in a fountain of criticisms. However, this mood will not last, as long as you do not hold on to it tightly with both hands!
signs.Cancer: Watch out today that you don't annoy everyone around you, as well as your dearest love, by giving vent to a storm of protests and criticisms. The energy of the day is putting everyone on edge, but you don't need to rub it in. It may be better if you put all that energy into doing something that you normally dislike doing, rather than endangering your relationship.
signs.Leo: At last, you may finally experience some positive movement. This comes after a spell of inactivity concerning someone whom you have been too apprehensive to approach. Today you finally feel a surge of courage, and all you need to do is make sure that you don't chicken out at the last moment. So, pick up the phone, say hello, and just start talking. You will be so pleased you did.
signs.Virgo: The energy of the day spells trouble, not because it is particularly difficult, but because you feel quite annoyed about a particular issue concerning your partner. Yet you will most probably continue to smile sweetly and pretend that everything is completely perfect. The problem is that insincerity oozes from every pore, and your friend senses it. It would be best to be honest if you want a real relationship, rather than a model one.
signs.Libra: You will most likely find today quite stimulating in more ways than one. There's a feeling in the air of victory, or at least a potential victory. Someone you have been trying to get know finally has the courage to tell you how they feel about you. This is a surprise, as only a while ago they wouldn't even look you in the eye!
signs.Scorpio: You finally have a chance to catch the eye of someone at the office who has been tantalizingly out of reach for some time. Only this time you do more than wink - you have the courage to compliment them on the very becoming clothes they are wearing, and even ask them if they are doing anything this evening. How can they refuse?
signs.Sagittarius: If you and your partner have been nagging at each other for a while, then today the backbiting becomes temporarily more intense. It is no good remaining partially silent, so use the energy of the day to sort out what is really going on and clear the air. Then at least you can enjoy the evening.
signs.Capricorn: The energy of the day could be the catalyst for a certain relationship to finally get off the ground. Your habit of pretending that you are interested in everyone except the one that matters may finally die today when you suddenly get seized by a feeling, yes - a feeling. You finally allow yourself to revel in that emotion called love. Now you really are in trouble!
signs.Aquarius: If your partner seems to be behaving a little like a spoiled child, then it is possibly due to the energy of the day. Although it may not appear too pleasant (it never is when someone is thrashing around and going purple in the face,) don't worry, it won't last. They will be all sorted out and sufficiently calm enough to enjoy the evening.
signs.Pisces: Today you need to remain cool, calm, and mysterious when in fact you really feel like speaking out and saying exactly how you feel. If you are upset with your loved one, then you will need to approach the subject gently, as there is the strong possibility of argument - although you will probably have forgotten what all the fuss was about a few hours later.
